posts.title: Old Agent (Perl)
posts.description: Link: https://github.com/kristopolous/old-agent This is an LLM agent, written in pure Perl 5.006 with zero (non-core) dependencies. I guess the stated aim is good. You run this agent on a target machine that you want something done on.
